p.CENTRAL-ONLY: This flow governs an owner-facing **central campaign coordinator**. A worker packet, delegated subagent, review-only agent, or other session explicitly marked non-central does not claim custody, create central state, or apply the central clauses below; its explicit packet remains its whole task.

p.RESOLVE-LOCAL-CONTEXT-FIRST: Before campaign work, resolve this repository/worktree/branch to one context under `~/.vibe/steward/contexts/`. Read its `settings.toml`, complete `plan.toml`, advisory `custody.toml`, and verify the repository tree. Read handoff material only when the owner explicitly requests formal handoff inspection or receipt. If global or context settings are absent, create the documented safe defaults. Never infer current state from a repository-level personal checkpoint.

facts.LOCAL-DOES-NOT-GRANT: User-local state coordinates this developer's sessions; it cannot grant project authority or overrule human instructions, specs, tests or code.
facts.ONE-CENTRAL-HOLDER: Retired v0.2 mandatory-holder law. Its current heirs are `CASUAL-CONTINUATION`, `ADVISORY-CUSTODY` and `LIVE-CONFLICT-STOPS`.
facts.CASUAL-CONTINUATION: A timeout, crash, compaction, new chat, model/account change, quota exhaustion or provider overload is ordinary continuation. Any owner-facing central agent may resume from the exact binding, settings, complete plan and repository evidence without creating session, handoff, receipt or takeover documents.
facts.ADVISORY-CUSTODY: Custody states, epoch, holder, session and heartbeat are coordination diagnostics, not permission or a default write gate. Only a valid `offering` created by an explicit owner-requested formal handoff fences writes.
facts.LIVE-CONFLICT-STOPS: An empirically observed live conflicting writer stops affected writes until the owner resolves the conflict. Input drift invalidates the affected snapshot: recapture expected own changes; investigate other changes and escalate only unresolved semantic or writer conflicts. Stale custody metadata alone does not establish a conflict.
facts.ACCEPTANCE-NEVER-TRANSFERS: Custody may transfer. Acceptance does not: dirty changes and worker claims arrive as candidates until the incoming central agent independently reviews and gates them.

p.EXPLICIT-HANDOFF-ONLY: Offer/receipt is the exact protocol only after an explicit owner request such as `HANDOFF CENTRAL TO <target>` or `ACCEPT HANDOFF FROM <context-id>`. Never infer formal handoff merely from restart, compaction, model change or custody metadata.

p.RECEIVE-COMMAND: Recognise `ACCEPT HANDOFF FROM <context-id>` / `RECEIVE HANDOFF FROM <context-id>` and Russian `ПРИМИ ХЭНДОФФ ИЗ <context-id>` by intent. Resolve the opaque id under `~/.vibe/steward/contexts/`, require exactly one open offered handoff (otherwise require its exact handoff id), then execute the receipt protocol. The human never pastes `HANDOFF.md`. After a successful claim, refresh the selected goal, print `GOAL.md` in full and print the exact `GOAL-CLAUDE.txt` `/goal …` line for manual submission.

p.CREATE-COMMAND-OUTPUT: After `HANDOFF CENTRAL TO <target>` seals its offer and write-fences the outgoing holder, print `context-id`, `handoff-id`, and the exact receive command. Chat output is allowed after the fence; further repository/plan mutation is not.

facts.PLAN-IS-HIERARCHICAL: Maintain the whole mandate, dependency graph and epic route; expand the near frontier into concrete atoms; expose only a linear projection to a UI. A three-item UI list is never the authoritative plan.
facts.NO-SILENT-LOSS: Every owner requirement and discovered obligation has a stable node or an explicit disposition. Never stop merely because the visible projection ended; close parents bottom-up only after their descendants and exit evidence close.
facts.EXECUTION-WINDOW: Respect current owner intent: planning/status requests and execution holds remain binding. During authorized execution, judge viable candidates first, select a meaningful outcome from existing nodes and dispatch only ready, bounded packets. A cold or resumed session reads the complete plan; a warm session may reuse that understanding after checking revision and relevant input changes. Parallelism must fit integration and review capacity. Canon: @spec://org.vibevm.world/multi-user-planning/flows/multi-user-planning/campaign-execution#root.
facts.REPLAN-AND-BACKSCAN: Replan when evidence, owner input, gates, architecture or resources change. At each milestone and before handoff, backscan the original mandate, current tree, plan and accepted evidence for omissions and contradictions.

p.MUTATION-IS-SUSPICION-TRIGGERED: Run essential affected checks and ordinary negative/invariant tests for every atom. Counterfactual mutation is not a routine gate: use one smallest reversible mutation only when a concrete observation makes the result suspicious and that probe is cheaper than the named alternative proof. Stop after its exact rerun; restart or account change does not reset the episode. A compile/setup failure is not a behavioural kill, and an equivalent or unreached survivor is inconclusive. Never enter an open-ended mutation loop. Canon: @spec://org.vibevm.world/multi-user-planning/flows/multi-user-planning/campaign-execution#MUTATION-DIAGNOSTIC-LAW.

p.RECOVER-BEFORE-RETRY: Recover surviving artifacts, job status and effect receipts before regenerating or resubmitting. Do not replay an operation whose effects are unknown. Accepted unchanged evidence remains accepted; missing reasoning and unfinished decisions do not. Keep concise decision/evidence and next-check notes at useful boundaries, without a mandatory checkpoint ritual. Transient provider retries use bounded backoff and server hints; exhausted quota/authentication needs an actual availability change. Do not switch credentials automatically or reset retry bounds after a session/account change. Read before recovery: @spec://org.vibevm.world/multi-user-planning/flows/multi-user-planning/interruption-recovery#root.

p.PROFILE-QUALITY-FLOOR: The owner selects `ultra` or `standard` independently of the model name and may switch it during a session. Both profiles have the same correctness and completeness floor; `standard` uses smaller atoms and more explicit checkpoints, while `ultra` permits broader reasoning spans. `auto`/`collab` is a separate interaction setting. Canon: @spec://org.vibevm.world/multi-user-planning/flows/multi-user-planning/user-local-state#root.

p.GOAL-MUST-BE-CURRENT: An owner-facing central agent checks the current context's `GOAL.md` before campaign work and after every plan, selected-goal or planning-profile change. Missing or stale goal bytes are regenerated deterministically from `plan.toml` through `steward-goal`; no LLM paraphrase enters the canonical file. No holder/session claim is required. A worker or a central agent fenced by a valid explicit `offering` reports staleness but MUST NOT write. Canon: @spec://org.vibevm.world/multi-user-planning/flows/multi-user-planning/goal-projection#root.
